title: Health360 Adoption and Executive Insights: license utilization, deployment status, and executive traffic, peer and incident views

prose.label: Adoption details.
prose.text: {{adoption-details}} {{adoption-trends}} No selectable time range, no values for Deployment Status and no definition of an active license are stated {{gap:adoption-definitions}}.

prose.label: Executive Insights.
prose.text: {{executive-insights-tabs}} {{executive-insights-applications}} The page states no time range, and introduces the Applications tab as private-application insights although its first section is about internet applications {{gap:executive-insights-page}}.

prose.label: Peers, network, cloud and incidents.
prose.text: {{executive-insights-peers}} The Industry Peer Comparison report is in [[zia.reports.executive:peer-comparison]]. {{executive-insights-network-cloud}} {{executive-insights-incidents}}

adoption-what.statement: The Adoption dashboard (Analytics > Health360 > Adoption) gives an overview of Zscaler platform adoption maturity at three levels: portfolio summaries for executive leadership, operational matrices by solution area, and product drilldowns.

quotes: The Adoption dashboard provides a centralized overview of Zscaler platform adoption maturity.
high-level portfolio summaries engineered for executive leadership, operational matrices segmenting specific solution areas, and granular product drilldowns
On the Adoption page (Analytics > Health360 > Adoption), you can:

adoption-page.statement: The page can hide or unhide unsubscribed services; Zscaler Platform shows deployed services per platform category, such as Users, Data Security, Branch, Cloud, AI Security and Security Ops, and Zscaler Products shows the subscriptions deployed per service, each tile with its license-utilization percentage.

quotes: Hide or unhide unsubscribed services to filter the adoption metrics data.
Zscaler Platform: View services deployed for each Zscaler platform category such as:
- Users - Data Security - Branch - Cloud - AI Security - Security Ops
Zscaler Products: View the total number of subscriptions deployed for each Zscaler service.
Each tile shows the percentage of license utilization.

adoption-details.statement: A product's adoption details page gives Products Deployed (subscriptions deployed for the service), Licenses Utilized (utilization percentage, with the active and total available licenses), and per subscription its Deployment Status and Utilization (licenses used versus purchased).

quotes: The adoption details page helps with granular Zscaler service drill-downs showing license utilization data and quantifiable value metrics.
Products Deployed: View the number of subscriptions deployed for the service.
Licenses Utilized: View the license utilization percentage for the service.
You can also see the number of active licenses and total available licenses.
Deployment Status: Whether the subscription is deployed for your organization or not.
Utilization: The number of licenses used versus the total licenses purchased.

adoption-trends.statement: The details page charts license utilization for the last 6 months; for Internet & SaaS only it charts SSL/TLS-inspected versus non-inspected traffic volume, and for Private Access only the number of application segments, each over the last 6 months.

quotes: License Utilization in Last 6 Months: View the graph showing license utilization trends for the last 6 months.
Traffic Zscaler is Processing for You (available for Internet & SaaS (ZIA) service only)
trends for the volume of SSL/TLS inspected traffic versus non-inspected traffic for the last 6 months
Application Segments in Your Organization (available for Private Access (ZPA) service only)
the number of application segment trends for the last 6 months

executive-insights-tabs.statement: Executive Insights (Analytics > Health360 > Executive Insights) gives a high-level overview of applications, network, cloud and incidents, with drill-down on each metric, and has tabs for private application insights, network insights, data center insights and incident insights.

quotes: Executive Insights provides a high-level overview of the applications, network, cloud, and incidents in your organization.
You can drill down on each metric to further analyze the data.
On the Executive Insights page (Analytics > Health360 > Executive Insights)
This tab shows private application-related insights
This tab contains network-related insights
This tab contains data center-related insights
This tab contains incident-related insights

executive-insights-applications.statement: The Applications tab shows a donut of traffic distribution across categories with the percentage change, a drill-down to the top 10 applications, and private-application traffic by host (for example AWS, GCP, Azure).

quotes: a donut chart showing the overall traffic distribution across various categories with the percentage increase or decrease in traffic flow
Click View Application to see the preceding information for the top 10 applications.
This section contains a graph showing the traffic data distribution for private applications for each host (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure).

executive-insights-peers.statement: The Applications tab also compares each category to industry peers: by accessing Health360 the organization gives Zscaler the right to compare its preceding month with peer organizations and all companies using the cloud service, with peers chosen by business vertical, geographic region and business size; the comparison covers overall traffic, configuration baseline, traffic distribution by application category and by region and access method, and product usage.

quotes: This section also contains a graph for comparing each category to your industry peers.

By accessing Zscaler Health360, you provide Zscaler the right to compare your organization's performance and effectiveness in using Zscaler services for the preceding month with other peer organizations and all companies using our cloud service.
Peers are chosen based on business vertical, geographic region, and business size.
The comparison is broken down by overall traffic, configuration baseline, traffic distribution by application categories, traffic distribution by region and access methods, and product usage.

executive-insights-network-cloud.statement: The Network tab shows total traffic per country split between office and remote and the top locations user traffic comes from; the Cloud tab shows total traffic for the top ZTEs for Internet/SaaS traffic.

quotes: Traffic by Access Path: The graph shows total organizational traffic segregated between office and remote data for each country.
Top Locations Users Are Coming From: The graph shows the top locations for your user traffic.
Top ZTEs for Internet/SaaS Traffic: The graph shows the total traffic data for top ZTEs.
This tab contains data center-related insights with the following section:
evidence.after: by switching the buttons at the top right. - Cloud

executive-insights-incidents.statement: The Incident tab shows the number of network and application incidents for the top 5 locations in descending order and a month-over-month incident trend, both filterable by incident severity.

quotes: Incidents by Location: The graph shows the number of network and application-related incidents for the top 5 locations in descending order.
in descending order. You can filter the graph by incident severity.
Incidents Trend (MoM): The graph shows the incident trend for each month. You can filter the graph by incident severity.

adoption-definitions.title: Adoption time range, Deployment Status values and the definition of an active license
adoption-definitions.detail: The Adoption pages state no time range for the summary tiles, no values for Deployment Status beyond whether a subscription is deployed, and no definition of an active license.

executive-insights-page.title: Executive Insights time range and the Applications tab's scope
executive-insights-page.detail: The Health360 Executive Insights page states no time range. It introduces the Applications tab as private application-related insights, but the tab's first section is titled What Internet Applications Are my Users Accessing?; the claims here follow what each section says.
